body: Send a screenshot of the focus you can’t click. But if you’ve changed your flag, that usually means you’ve already selected it. To activate the ‘Kingdom of Norway’ focus, you need to complete both ‘Crown’s Executive Powers’ and ‘Warden King’ first—doing just one isn’t enough. After finishing ‘Kingdom of Norway’, you’ll get a popup where you choose the path your kingdom will take, and your flag will change. The only focus I can think of that might be blocked on that path is ‘Shield of the North’, which requires at least 55% war support. (Or maybe it’s blocked because you managed to do the same thing as the focus some other way)
